scope: Ten named published records selected for exact-baseline defence-posture enrichment.

prospects.name: C3RiOS open-architecture RPAS avionics
prospects.fitSummary: NRC support is funding C3RiOS to develop a dual-use, open-architecture, certifiable RPAS avionics platform with moving-map, synthetic-vision, terrain-awareness, and mission-information functions for civil and government missions.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Selected after live-baseline comparison confirmed a material non-duplicative gap.

prospects.name: Atreides multi-domain unmanned-system data platform
prospects.fitSummary: PacifiCan awarded Atreides defence-innovation funding to commercialize an AI software platform for collecting, sharing, and analyzing data from unmanned systems across land, air, and maritime environments.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Selected after live-baseline comparison confirmed a material non-duplicative gap.

prospects.name: GSTS OCIANA maritime defence intelligence
prospects.fitSummary: ACOA awarded GSTS defence investment to develop and commercialize OCIANA, a maritime vessel-tracking AI platform for defence, security, and supply-chain applications, while expanding its facility and workforce.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Selected after live-baseline comparison confirmed a material non-duplicative gap.

prospects.name: Canadian UAVs BVLOS reconnaissance platform
prospects.fitSummary: PrairiesCan awarded Canadian UAVs defence investment to deliver a deployable long-endurance beyond-visual-line-of-sight drone platform and intelligence suite for reconnaissance and situational-awareness applications.

recoveryAttempts.outcome: Selected after live-baseline comparison confirmed a material non-duplicative gap.

prospects.name: Galaxia SpaceLEO orbital edge computing
